configurePresets.name: intel2023
configurePresets.description: AdaptiveCpp with the Level Zero backend (native for Intel GPUs), minimal feature profile, Intel oneAPI compiler. The OpenCL backend is intentionally OFF: it requires a full Khronos OpenCL ICD-Loader install (providing OpenCLICDLoaderConfig.cmake), which the oneAPI libOpenCL.so does not ship.
